intent: Every Account must have at least one relationship of any type in either direction. Report an error when this is false.
An Account may have at most one incoming OWNS relationship from a Customer. Zero owners are allowed by this particular rule. Report an error for multiple owners.
Require an email property on 100% of Customer nodes, including special customers. A breach must be a warning, not an error.
All existing Account.balance values must have integer runtime type. Report an error for values of another type.
Each Account.type must belong to the allowed set checking, savings, shell. Report an error for values outside this set.
Account.id must be unique across Account nodes. Report an error for duplicate values.
Assert that the actual number of Customer nodes is exactly 1500. This is a value regression assertion on the count, including all Customer nodes. Report an error if the actual count differs.

For customer CUST-RING-LEADER-0, the distinct Account IDs reachable by one to four outgoing CONTROLS hops must include ACC-2401 and ACC-2408. Other reachable accounts are allowed. Use a query parameter for the customer ID and compare returned account IDs. Report an error if either required account is missing.
Every Transaction must have exactly one incoming SENT relationship from an Account. Report an error when this count differs from one.
Use a drift check to ensure the number of OWNS relationships has not dropped by more than 10% relative to the supplied latest baseline profile. Report an error if the drop exceeds 10%.
